semantic.justification: Shared realm-local Emscripten runtime bootstrap now owns actual compiled libc/libxml2/MEMFS module identity and initialization Promise. Existing XML bootstrap/getter delegates to this owner while retaining its original uninitialized diagnostic, native XML exports and byte-marshalling/lifetime. The actual public Emscripten4.0.19 FS export supplies a real isolated MEMFS, not a JavaScript replacement file map or TempFile facade. Native C xmlCtxtReadFile consumes files written through this exact runtime filesystem, including Unicode names/content, independent descriptors, positional IO/truncate/unlink/open-inode lifetime and genuine errno errors. No host filesystem is mounted and no network or global-user-file access is introduced. This is only the platform runtime prerequisite: original OSL/SvFileStream/TempFileFastService/OStorage/backend/model/filter/UI remain unfinished; native filesystem/error/locking/large-offset/full source QA parity is unqualified.
